units.source_text: 我逃竄似的又跑回樓頂，躺在地上，仰望噙滿雨水的夏日夜空，

en.t: I fled back up to the rooftop, lay down on the ground, and gazed up at the summer night sky heavy with rain,

units.source_text: 那時襲擾我的情感不是憤怒，也不是厭惡，更非悲傷，而是極度的恐懼。

en.t: and the feeling that overwhelmed me then was not anger, nor disgust, nor even sadness, but an extreme terror.

units.source_text: 它不是對墳墓幽靈的恐懼，

en.t: It was not the fear one feels toward ghosts in a graveyard,

units.source_text: 也許是在神社的杉樹林中，撞見縹緲的白衣神靈時，所產生的那種古老、殘酷、難以言喻的恐怖感。

en.t: but perhaps the ancient, merciless, indescribable dread one might feel on encountering a faint white-robed deity among the cedar trees of a shrine.

units.source_text: 從那天夜晚，我長出了白髮，漸漸對一切失去信心，漸漸對人充滿無限的懷疑，

en.t: From that night on, my hair began to turn white, and little by little I lost confidence in everything and became filled with boundless suspicion toward people,

units.source_text: 永久遠離對人世生活的一切期待、喜悅與共鳴。

en.t: forever withdrawing from every expectation, joy, and sympathy connected with life in the human world.

units.source_text: 事實上，這是我人生中最具有決定性的一次事件。

en.t: In truth, this was the most decisive event of my life.
